name: MOVE
desc: MOVE relocation and deletion of JSON values, subtree overwrites, sequential path evaluation, auto-vivification after detachment, namespace restrictions, deferred array deletion and half-index insertion, immediate appends, current-node replacement, and SPLIT metadata. Error flags distinguish input-dependent runtime failures from stronger diagnoses justified by static analysis. No optional features or resource limits are required.

tests.name: Cannot move an array element twice
tests.desc: The first pair makes index zero inaccessible for the remaining pairs; static analysis can prove failure whenever that pair succeeds.

tests.desc: A pending deletion also makes all descendants inaccessible.

tests.desc: References evaluated within paths must respect pending array deletions.

tests.name: Cannot move a removed object property twice
tests.desc: Object deletion takes effect immediately.

tests.name: Cannot move an object property into itself twice after deletion
tests.desc: Equal paths do not bypass the missing-source check.

tests.name: Cannot leave the current root deleted
tests.desc: The current node must be replaced before MOVE ends for every input.

tests.name: Cannot leave an AT current node deleted
tests.desc: Moving the current node into TEMP without replacement is forbidden.

tests.name: TEMP does not persist between MOVE actions
tests.desc: Each action receives fresh temporaries, so the second source is always missing.

tests.desc: Read-only namespace paths are INVALID_OPERAND; their use as MOVE sources can be rejected statically.

tests.name: Cannot move to CONST
tests.desc: Read-only namespace paths are INVALID_OPERAND even when the path would otherwise be writable.

tests.name: Cannot move from CAP
tests.desc: Read-only namespace paths are INVALID_OPERAND; their use as MOVE sources can be rejected statically.

tests.name: Cannot move to CAP
tests.desc: Read-only namespace paths are INVALID_OPERAND even when the path would otherwise be writable.

tests.name: Cannot move from the STASH root
tests.desc: MOVE explicitly forbids either endpoint being a non-current namespace root.

tests.name: Cannot move to the STASH root
tests.desc: MOVE explicitly forbids either endpoint being a non-current namespace root.

tests.name: Cannot move from the TEMP root

tests.name: Cannot move to the TEMP root
tests.desc: MOVE forbids other namespace roots; TEMP also requires a nonempty path.

tests.name: Reject a nested array after path expansion
tests.desc: Array path expressions expand only one level.

tests.name: Reject an object as the source path
tests.desc: MOVE calls structurally invalid endpoints INVALID_TARGET; general path validation may diagnose INVALID_GRAFT statically.

tests.name: Reject an object as the destination path
tests.desc: MOVE calls structurally invalid endpoints INVALID_TARGET; general path validation may diagnose INVALID_GRAFT statically.

tests.name: Reject an escaped-array destination
tests.desc: An escaped literal array is not a reference expression; MOVE allows INVALID_TARGET and static path validation may return INVALID_GRAFT.

tests.name: Reject an incomplete MOVE pair
tests.desc: Each source must have a destination.

tests.name: An intentional failure in a path is not upgraded
tests.desc: FAIL intentionally produces INVALID_TARGET, which static analysis must not upgrade.

tests.name: Half-index insertion carries SPLIT trimming metadata
tests.desc: Moving the first element to an insertion point preserves its original left and right trimming.

tests.name: Overwriting an element preserves destination SPLIT metadata
tests.desc: The moved value adopts the existing destination trimming instead of carrying its source trimming.

tests.name: Appending carries SPLIT trimming metadata
A TEMP object property drops element SPLIT metadata
tests.desc: The inserted value receives adjacent metadata, which is applied after the final element order is known.

tests.name: An auto-vivified TEMP array preserves element SPLIT metadata
Restoring a deleted position restores SPLIT element metadata
Queued half-index insertions cannot be read as sources
tests.desc: Queued values are inaccessible. An implementation may reject the computed half-index source as an invalid operand before attempting the read.

tests.name: Cannot descend through a queued half-index insertion
tests.desc: A half index is permitted only as the final destination selector; queued insertions cannot be modified through deeper paths.

tests.name: Cannot auto-vivify through a half index
tests.desc: Half-index paths cannot create intermediate parents, even if no insertion has been queued yet.

tests.name: Pending deletion restrictions follow an array into TEMP
tests.desc: Moving the array does not make its pending-deletion positions readable.

tests.name: Half-index insertion carries variable separator metadata
tests.desc: The semicolon follows the moved a while the comma follows b.

tests.name: Overwrite retains destination separator metadata
tests.desc: Overwriting b preserves its comma separator instead of moving the source semicolon.

tests.name: Different SPLIT origins do not transfer element metadata
tests.desc: The source metadata belongs to a different split, so the inserted x receives adjacent destination metadata.
